summary.text: Simon Cataldo is a Democratic state representative from the 14th Middlesex District who has held the seat since January 4, 2023 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026. He is an attorney and former federal prosecutor.

paragraphs.text: Simon Cataldo earned a B.A. in environmental science from Colorado College in 2008, an M.S. in urban education from the City University of New York in 2010, and a J.D. from the University of Virginia in 2014.

His career experience includes working as counsel with The Ashcroft Law Firm, LLC, as a trial attorney with the U.S. Department of Justice Criminal Division, and as a judicial law clerk with the U.S. Court of Appeals.
He succeeded Tami Gouveia in the 14th Middlesex District seat in 2023.
In the 2025-2026 session he is vice chair of the Environment, Natural Resources and Agriculture Joint Committee and also serves on the Education, Financial Services and Judiciary joint committees.
